scope: Offline private mainnet preparation and launch admission; synthetic process records plus actual Linux kernel-name fixture using one ordinary Python child
regressionReproducedBeforeFix: Preparation accepted a synthetic active test-validator record with the Linux-truncated comm name

local.skipReason: Actual Linux comm fixture requires Linux

checks: Both private preparation and launch use the shared visible process census
Full and truncated validator comm names refuse
Executable argv[0] and kernel executable links refuse even when comm differs
Unrelated argument mentions do not become false validator detections
Spaces and parentheses in stat names do not confuse process state
Zombie/exited records are ignored; disappearing PIDs are tolerated
Missing process filesystem, malformed state and incomplete/unreadable live evidence refuse
An active-validator refusal occurs before creating the launch ledger or starting a process
Actual Linux truncation is verified with a bounded ordinary Python child, never Agave
limitations: Visible admission-time census only; a later process start is not atomically excluded
Not protection against malicious or hidden host processes
Current host remains below unchanged resource requirements
Actual fresh hashing genesis, two startup replays, full-validator consensus/recovery and independent operators remain pending
